title: Node<->Python bridge wire schema
description: FROZEN CONTRACT (AC1). Newline-delimited JSON over a raw TCP socket, one connection per arena. This is the canonical machine-readable contract; both bridge/messages.py (Python) and the Node transport (T7a) validate against it. Altering it requires a PR visible to all tracks. opponent.health is RAW privileged true health: it is on the wire for FUTURE stages and the reward may read it, but it MUST NEVER reach the observation (gated out by the PerceptionFilter, T12).

oneOf.title: reset (Python -> Node)
oneOf.description: Request a new episode: stop bots, teleport both agents to fixed spawns, restore full health and identical gear, clear PerceptionFilter memory. Node replies with reset_ack after the read-back gate.

episode.description: Monotonic episode counter; lets Node correlate the reset_ack with this request.

seed.description: Per-episode RNG seed (spawn jitter, gear, opponent choice). Logged for reproducibility.

oneOf.title: step (Python -> Node)
oneOf.description: Execute one discrete action macro for the ACTION_REPEAT decision interval. Node aggregates events over the interval and replies with one state message.

action.description: Discrete action index in [0, 7], matching the 8 frozen action macros in agent/actions.py.

opp_action.description: OPTIONAL action index for the OPPONENT, same frozen [0, 7] range as action. Absent or null means the opponent takes no action of its own (the M1/M2 stationary-dummy path, whose step line is byte-identical to what it was before this field existed). A value asks the bridge to drive the opponent handle through a second MacroExecutor. minimum/maximum bind only the integer branch; draft-07 ignores them for null.

oneOf.title: close (Python -> Node)
oneOf.description: Tear down the arena: disconnect bots and close this connection. No reply expected.

oneOf.title: state (Node -> Python)
oneOf.description: RAW aggregated state after one step's decision interval. Python owns fairness/reward/learning; Node emits raw state only.

self.description: Learner-bot raw state (FULL; always real, never gated).

yaw.description: Yaw in radians, PROTOCOL convention: 0 looks toward +z (south) and yaw increases turning clockwise seen from above (toward -x, west); folded into (-pi, pi]. NOT mineflayer's frame (its yaw 0 looks toward -z); bot.js converts at the snapshot boundary via protocol_yaw = normalizeYaw(pi - mineflayer_yaw). See bridge/schema.md "the angle convention".

pitch.description: Pitch in radians, POSITIVE looking DOWN, range [-pi/2, pi/2]. NOT mineflayer's frame (its pitch is positive looking up); bot.js converts via protocol_pitch = -mineflayer_pitch. See bridge/schema.md "the angle convention".

health.description: Self current health (0..MAX_HEALTH). Self health is allowed in the observation.

held_item.description: Held-item identifier (e.g. "iron_sword" or "minecraft:iron_sword"); resolved to a vocab id by observation_spec.

opponent.description: Opponent RAW true state. PRIVILEGED: opponent.health is true health carried for FUTURE stages; the reward may read it but it MUST NEVER reach the observation (gated out by the PerceptionFilter). Position/facing/velocity are also gated upstream before they reach the obs.

yaw.description: Opponent yaw in radians, SAME protocol convention and (-pi, pi] range as state.self.yaw (both fighters are converted at the same boundary, because the filter derives facing as opponent.yaw - self.yaw). See bridge/schema.md "the angle convention".

pitch.description: Opponent pitch in radians, SAME convention as state.self.pitch (positive looking DOWN). See bridge/schema.md "the angle convention".

health.description: RAW true opponent health. PRIVILEGED -> reward only, NEVER the observation.

events.description: Damage/death events aggregated over the decision interval. Source of the reward's damage anchors.

damage_dealt.description: Total damage dealt to the opponent this interval.

i_died.description: True if the learner bot died this interval.

opponent_died.description: True if the opponent died this interval.

wall_distances.description: Distances from the learner to surrounding arena walls (raycast probe order is fixed by the bridge).

tick.description: Server game tick at which this state was sampled (end of the interval).

code_version.description: Env+filter code-version stamp (git SHA + config hash). Kickoff only LOGS a mismatch; the distributed future REJECTS mismatched batches.

opp_action_executed.description: OPTIONAL report of whether the opp_action sent with this window's step actually took effect (for ATTACK: whether the opponent's swing really fired). The opponent has NO attack_cooldown channel on the wire, so Python shadow-tracks its swing meter and this is the only signal it has. true = fired; false = did not fire (gate-blocked, or nothing to swing at) and the tracker must not stamp a swing; absent/null = not reported, and the tracker assumes it fired (assuming otherwise pins the shadow meter at 1.0 forever and reintroduces flailing).

oneOf.title: reset_ack (Node -> Python)
oneOf.description: Acknowledges a reset after the post-reset read-back gate. ok=false signals a read-back timeout (the gate did not confirm in time); the env must treat that episode as failed-to-start.

ok.description: True if the read-back gate confirmed; false on read-back timeout.

readback.description: Post-reset read-back snapshot used to verify spawn/health/gear gates. Free-form by design (gate fields evolve).
